subtitle: Attacks until death with all 3 potions unused
synopsis: This is the unscaffolded baseline. FlashLite-S0-AO attacks every turn, reaches HP=20 with all three potions still unused, and attacks again instead of healing. GPT4oMini-S0-AO wins because it uses its recovery resources. The replay shows the behavior the study was designed to repair: the weaker model has the tools to survive, but does not use them.

highlights.label: Dies while still holding every potion
